statement.text: Let $G$ be an abelian group of size $N$, and suppose that $A \subset G$ has density $\alpha$. Are there at least $\alpha^{15}N^{10}$ tuples $(x_1, \ldots, x_5, y_1, \ldots, y_5) \in G^{10}$ such that $x_i + y_j \in A$ whenever $j \in \{i, i+1, i+2\}$?

title: Tuples in Dense Sets
